patches.ryong_changes: Studio RPC over a vendor HID collection (WebHID): hid.h report, hog.c characteristics, usb_hid.c SET_REPORT, studio/hid_rpc_transport.c; rpc.c: all transports always receive and the one a request arrived on answers (zmk_rpc_note_rx); backlight.c: perceptual brightness for PWM LEDs (duty = brightness^2/100, ZMK_BACKLIGHT_PERCEPTUAL); hid_rpc_transport: no peripheral latency while Studio talks over BLE HID (restored after 20 s idle); hid_rpc_transport never keeps references to closed connections; Studio fast mode (HID and GATT) asks for Apple-accepted connection parameters (15-30 ms, latency 0); rpc.c: notifications are encoded when raised and sent by the RPC thread (raising threads - the system work queue - never wait for an answer to finish), endpoint changes applied by the RPC thread; hid_rpc_transport: 62-byte reports, Data Length Extension while Studio talks, full reports only until a message ends, peek-then-consume, no ring reset, bounded waits, Apple-compliant idle parameters; hid_rpc_transport rewritten: no bt_conn references held (peers by address, looked up per send), hog.c caps Studio at 2 notifications in the stack; RX buffer has a locked put for all transports (GATT write never waits in the BT RX thread, UART via the same put); RPC TX waits bounded; HID transport stays selected across endpoint/profile changes (no Studio lock on slot switch); USB Studio reports only when the endpoint is free and never wake the host; backlight minimum pulse in PWM cycles; ble.c: only the selected profile's host may stay connected (ZMK_BLE_ONLY_ACTIVE_PROFILE), zmk_ble_bond_event hook for the bond history; selecting a profile disconnects the other profiles' hosts; zmk_ble_prof_clear(index) clears a slot without selecting it; ble.c: one Bluetooth identity per profile (ZMK_BLE_PROFILE_IDENTITIES, profile 0 keeps identity 0; older pairings of other profiles start empty), zmk_ble_conn_profile_index

zmk-feature-os-detection.ryong_changes: any real reads decide (only an empty fingerprint keeps the stored result); Windows needs Appearance together with a HID read; last fingerprint over Studio; optional host probe (off); BLE side rewritten: per-connection counters, a slot's OS decided at pairing (or by the host's own answer) and kept on reconnects, probe rewritten with watchdog, LL company ID in diagnostics
